relationships.rationale: Catalog mutation lifecycle is surfaced by the plugin settings GUI, but GUI accessibility and privacy remain a distinct consumer contract.
Catalog lifecycle depends on discovery and trust validation, while discovery identity and manifest trust retain their own authority.
Runtime packaging and health determine browser capability availability, but browser-session transitions remain a separate runtime lifecycle.
The browser/Site Reader identity boundary constrains chat web routing without merging browser interaction with web operations.
Session sharing may expose context to capture, but capture creates artifacts with a separate privacy, redaction, retention, and atomicity lifecycle.
Provider routing and fallback depend on the canonical provider-operation matrix, whose governance identity remains distinct from execution.
Each batched request uses provider routing and fallback, while batch concurrency, timeout, and fail-fast state remain distinct.
Chat web operations depend on the shared dispatcher contract to couple command, operation, tool, input, and result.
GitHub Actions remote mutations require a valid GitHub connection and credential lifecycle, which retains separate security and recovery authority.
LSP restart behavior depends on persisted restart budgets and backoff state, while query-result lifecycle remains separate.
Platform hook adapters invoke lifecycle middleware, but adapter trust, deduplication, and provider-specific fallback remain distinct.
The web dispatcher may route a nested BrowserAction, but BrowserAction payload validation retains its own action-specific schema.
The BrowserAction nesting invariant depends on a valid BrowserAction payload while preserving Site Reader / BrowserAction ownership.
Web jobs may read and write cache state, but job terminal-state consistency is distinct from cache lookup and persistence policy.
The web-operation job lifecycle depends on durable progress, cancellation, partial-result, and terminal payload persistence without merging storage authority into job execution.
